summary: Verified the Company Pages 'Post Now' 520-Cloudflare fix (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 15/15 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_company_pages.py) - added 4 new tests for the post endpoint: graceful-failure regression (status must be one of 200/400/401/403/502 with application/json, never a gateway/HTML page), 404 for non-existent org_id, 422 for missing content, and failed-post-recorded-in-history. Live curl: POST /api/company-pages/69021406/post -> HTTP 401 in 0.35s with JSON {'detail':'LinkedIn token expired or missing w_organization_social permission...'} - exactly the expected graceful failure (backend log shows LinkedIn EXPIRED_ACCESS_TOKEN 65602 handled). POST with a non-existent image_path also returns 401 (no crash on missing file). POST /api/company-pages/69021406/generate still returns 200 with real GPT-4o content. Frontend: agent gate (Agent@2024!) -> Company Pages nav renders all 5 cards (Fundle.ai 69021406, TagandPay 143338927, HearClear India 142891970, FundleXperiences 105361431, Exceed Digital 125583973) plus the 'LinkedIn OAuth Required' banner. Clicking 'Post Now' (with /generate stubbed for speed so the REAL post endpoint is exercised) produced a 401 JSON response, a native alert containing the exact backend detail, the Post Now button re-enabled, the generated-content preview preserved, and the app still rendered (no Cloudflare page). No unexpected console errors beyond the expected 401 AxiosError.

minor.issue: total_posts and posts_today count ALL company_posts documents including status='failed' attempts, while the auto-poster's cap check counts only status='published'. UI therefore showed Fundle.ai as '5 total posts, 5/4 today' purely from failed attempts - misleading stats. Add {'status':'published'} to both count_documents filters.
Image upload block swallows all errors (logger only) and proceeds to post without the image; the client gets success with no indication the infographic was dropped.
org_id is not sanitized (strip/rstrip('/')) here or on PUT/DELETE/generate - only on POST create. Carried over from iteration_21.
Still accepts raw `data: dict` with no Pydantic model. Carried over from iteration_20/21.

run_company_auto_poster runs every 5 min and burns a full GPT-4o + Gemini image generation before hitting the guaranteed LinkedIn 401 - visible in backend logs ('Auto-infographic generated ... Auto-post generation error'). Wasted LLM spend until OAuth is fixed; consider a token pre-check before generating.

integration_issues.issue: Works correctly (alert shows the backend detail, button re-enabled, preview kept) but uses window.alert() instead of the app's toast pattern - inconsistent/blocking. Cosmetic, carried over.

issues: Stats line shows '5/4 today' (over the configured daily cap) because failed posts are counted - backend counting bug above.
Expand/Collapse, Delete (trash) and Discard buttons still have no data-testid.
Generated infographic is still not previewed before posting (image_path remains an absolute FS path, no /uploads static route).

Optional: pre-check LinkedIn token validity in run_company_auto_poster before running the LLM/image generation to avoid wasted AI spend on guaranteed 401s.

LinkedIn posting cannot be tested for SUCCESS until an OAuth token with w_organization_social is connected. rca_of_the_issue: Original 520: the httpx.AsyncClient POST to LinkedIn was un-guarded, so a connection/transport exception escaped the FastAPI handler and killed the worker connection, which Cloudflare surfaced as 520. Fix wraps the request in try/except (502 + failed-post record) and translates LinkedIn non-2xx codes to 401/403/400 with JSON detail. Verified by curl (401 JSON in 0.35s), pytest regression asserting only JSON statuses are ever returned, and a Playwright run of the real Post Now button showing the alert instead of a gateway page.
